tagline: The True Original Always Pumping Ahead
notes: Deccan Pumps Pvt Ltd (D-Plus Deccan branding, part of the EKKI Group). Its site lists only openwell submersibles among submersibles (no borewell line). Series names come from the image file names on the brand page, which shows no text names. Phase for some series is inferred. Prices are retailer listings (MRP where shown); HOKVR/HOK/HOT bands are single models whose series is inferred from the model code (DH10R / DH15 / DTH10). Model rows come from a third-party-hosted Deccan/EKKI performance chart (IndiaMART seller upload, datasheet_url); features and operating limits are from deccanpumps.com; descriptions are composed from those page figures.
